name: workscene
description: Discover, organize, and return to development workspaces
author: WorkScene contributors

scripts.package:extension: npm run build && cd extension && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o ../release/workscene-connector.vsix
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:extension && electron-builder --mac dir zip --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run package:extension && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts docs .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json extension/package.json extension/README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts docs .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json extension/package.json extension/README.md
